data.name: Stunning Fist
data.description: When you use your Stunning Fist ability, you can choose to expend your psionic focus to gain a +%1 bonus to the save DC of that Stunning Fist attack.  If you expend your psionic focus for the Psionic Fist feat as part of a Stunning Fist attack, you gain this bonus in addition to the bonus damage from Stunning Fist.|EnlightenedMonkStunningFistDCBonus
